locDef.Gulf-front: First row on the Gulf: listed or described as beachfront, or within about 100 m of the shoreline and not across the street from it
locDef.Bay / lagoon / canal: Backs onto Little Lagoon, a canal, a bayou, the Intracoastal or Mobile / Bon Secour / Wolf / Perdido Bay, or has its own or a community dock or pier on it; not on the Gulf

areas.name: Gulf Shores

areas.name: Orange Beach
areas.sub: The City of Orange Beach (ZIP 36561): Perdido Beach Blvd to Perdido Pass and the back bays
